speaker: josias_thwaite
text: St Michael and all angels. The feast itself falls tomorrow. This morning the parish keeps the angels.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Nine orders stand between this parish and the dark. I will name the one who stands at the door, and leave the other eight to Monday.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Attend with your ear. The hand may stay where it is. A parish will call a still man devout, and I have not the time to correct them.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then sit. Michael's sword is not a surgeon's, and the collect does not ask you to be comfortable.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The collect, then. I have the morning, and no other place I am due.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: You are due to be still. That is the whole of this hour. The king you are saving your mouth for is not in this church.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I heard the mayor's response. I will not answer it. It was not said to me.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Nor should you. His amen is the book's. Keep the hand, Master Shakespeare, and let the parish have its reading.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will keep it. I have not claimed their word for it.
